newsitem.title: USA: Kapson Senior Quarters Q1 net loss widens.
newsitem.headline: Kapson Senior Quarters Q1 net loss widens.

text.p: Pro forma net loss per share -- ( .05)
NOTE: Kapson Senior Quarters Corp said it reported pro forma results for its first quarter of 1996 because of its initial public offering in October 1996.

The company said the net loss for the first quarter of 1997 was reduced due to delays and higher than expected costs associated with the New York State Assisted Living Program (ALP). Kapson was not able to implement the program in its East Northport, New York and Centereach, New York facilities which would have enabled the company to apply for and receive reimbursement for Medicaid-eligible individuals. Excluding the impact of ALP, net loss would have been $131,000, or $0.02 per share.
